lessons.claim: Oldroyd-B (= a dilute Hookean dumbbell) predicts no shear thinning at all -- confirmed by execution: eta_p has a scatter of 6e-14 across 4 decades of gdot. N1 = 2 eta_p lambda_p gdot^2 and N2 = 0. Being derived for dilute linear chains only, it must not be used as a general polymer-fluid model, and if shear thinning appears it is not the model but the system that is different
